rules.text: A github.com url carries the Github tag.
description never ends with a period.
One live grocery item per name (case-insensitive).
A grocery item cannot be soft-deleted while a recipe, cocktail, meal or grocery run still references it.
reason is set only when status is Canceled.
A row with date_watched has a terminal status.
A movie cannot be soft-deleted while a live quote still references it (quotes.movie_id).
There is no Watched status. A watched movie is Finished; date_watched is the date.
Priority means need to watch / dying to see. It is not a favorite marker; use tags for that.
